contexts.text: The reason Aaron... and his sons were anointed, and also their very garments, was that they might represent the Lord as to the Divine good, and the derivative Divine truth; Aaron, as to the Divine good, and his sons as to the derivative Divine truth... AE 502:4.
Aaron, as the high-priest = the good of love to the Lord.
O house of Aaron trust ye in Jehovah (). House of Aaron = all who are in the good of love.

Aaron himself represented the Lord as to the priesthood, which is His Celestial Kingdom; and his garments represented in general the Spiritual Kingdom; for this invests the Celestial Kingdom... and therefore the Divine truth is signified in general by the garments of Aaron...

For Moses and Aaron represented the Lord as to the Law, which is the Word... and the rod of Aaron blossomed, and brought forth almonds () because his rod represented... truth from the good of love, (which) is the only truth that produces fruit, which is the good of charity.
Aaron represented the Lord's priesthood; and therefore the seed of Aaron = those who are in the affection of genuine truth which is from celestial good. Illustration.
